One of '''Rakatan vaults''' in the [[abandoned Rakata machine chamber]] in [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], was converted into a barracks for warriors of the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] after they were released during the [[invasion of Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Esh-kha warrior barracks is a location in the Tomb on the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
